prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D pixel-art character sprite sheet for an existing warm modern tavern browser game.
The input is an IDENTITY / COLOR / COSTUME reference, NOT the desired layout. Expand this EXACT character into ONE new transparent sprite sheet of EXACTLY 20 small full-body sprites in a REGULAR 4-column by 5-row grid. Portrait canvas aspect 4:5. Equal cell sizes, each subject centered, entire character inside its cell with generous clear gutters, every foot at same baseline within its cell, same head/body scale for all20. No outlines around cells, NO text, numbers, labels, panels, shadows, symbols, background or watermark. Real alpha transparency.
Match reference crisp nearest-neighbor chibi pixel-art style; visible square pixel clusters, limited palette, dark pixel outlines, about64-80 logical pixels character height. Preserve identity and all distinctive accessories; keep clothing appropriate as in the reference. Two opposing walk contacts must differ visibly in feet/arms, subtle torso sway. True BACK view hides face; true LEFT and RIGHT profiles point their nose/feet in those directions and show side silhouette, NOT front views mirrored. No fake camera rotation, no duplicate frontal poses for side/back. Never add props that obscure faces. Do NOT crop ears/tails/wings/hair.
EXACT row-major frame layout (not all rows same orientation):
Row1: FRONT neutral idle; FRONT walk left foot forward; FRONT walk right foot forward; FRONT eyes-closed blink.
Row2: BACK idle; BACK walk left foot forward; BACK walk right foot forward; FRONT cheerful smile.
Row3: LEFT profile idle; LEFT profile walk contact A; LEFT profile opposite contact B; FRONT sad/pouting.
Row4: RIGHT profile idle; RIGHT profile walk contact A; RIGHT profile opposite contact B; FRONT mildly angry/determined.
Row5: FRONT thinking hand-to-chin; FRONT surprised wide eyes; FRONT focused working gesture; FRONT tired/sleepy.
Expressions must change eyes/brows/mouth clearly at tiny game scale. Pose and face only; keep outfit consistent. All20 frames equally sized/full-body.
